📺 Legion (2017–2019)

Legion follows David Haller, a troubled young man who has spent much of his life struggling with mental illness and mysterious experiences he cannot explain. After years in psychiatric hospitals, David discovers that the voices and visions haunting him may actually be connected to extraordinary mutant abilities. When he meets Syd Barrett, a mysterious woman with powers of her own, his life takes a dramatic turn as he becomes involved with a group of mutants determined to help him understand his true identity. However, powerful enemies and dangerous secrets threaten to destroy everything he believes about himself. As David explores his abilities, the boundaries between reality and imagination become increasingly blurred. Inspired by Marvel Comics, Legion combines psychological suspense, superhero action, and mind-bending storytelling while exploring identity, power, love, and the complexity of the human mind.

🎭 Genre: Sci-Fi • Drama • Action • Psychological Thriller

⭐ IMDb: 8.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 45–60 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Noah Hawley

📺 Where to Watch: Hulu in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Legion is an American surrealist superhero television series created by Noah Hawley for FX, based on the Marvel Comics character Legion. It was produced by FX Productions in association with Marvel Television, with Hawley serving as showrunner, and ran for three seasons from February 8, 2017, to August 12, 2019. It is set in a universe parallel to the X-Men film series. Dan Stevens stars as David Haller, a mutant diagnosed with schizophrenia at a young age. The series follows David as he tries to control his psychic powers and combat the sinister forces trying to manipulate him to their own ends.
